svg.title: erikwang2013/etcd architecture diagram
svg.desc: Five layers: framework adapters, facade, subsystem clients, transport and the etcd server, plus cross-cutting concerns, the message layer and the exception tree.
svg.text: PHP etcd v3 client — layers, dependency direction and error semantics
retry / auth; falls back to ETCD_*
only transport-level failures retry, up to retry
the gRPC-gateway wants key / value as
byte for the upper bound; all-0xFF falls back
Exception tree — all extend RuntimeException, split by retryable semantics
